main.description: A person's review of one thing: which adjectives it is, and is not. One record per subject per repo; update it rather than creating another. If a repo ever holds more than one review of the same subject, merge them into the earliest-created one (tag conflicts: latest updatedAt wins, then direction nearer 0, then positive) and delete the rest.

subject.description: The thing being tagged, described well enough to display without fetching the referenced record. Readers can decide whether the cid must match for their purposes, or whether the at-uri alone is enough.

tags.description: The adjectives this review applies to the subject. An adjective should appear at most once; readers keep the last entry when it repeats.

locale.description: The language the whole review is meant to be read in (BCP 47), not the language of any one adjective. Readers may render the sentence in this locale.

uri.description: The atproto record that represents the thing being tagged.

cid.description: The uri's cid when this tag was last updated.

title.description: The name of the thing being tagged, usually copied from a field on the subject record.

type.description: The kind of thing the subject is. Open set; add values as lenses support them.

identifiers.description: External identifiers for the subject, such as imdbId or isbn13.

direction.description: Whether the subject *is* the adjective (1), *is not* the adjective (-1) or, less commonly, *really* is (2), or *really* isn't (-2). A value of zero is an explicit 'no comment', uncertainty, or lack of opinion.

adjective.description: An adjective, in any language, that the subject either is, or is not.
